"""Naive reference implementation of the stream semantics (for testing)."""
import json


def eval_tree(node, prefix):
    while True:
        if "class" in node:
            return node["class"]
        j = node["feature"]; z = node["threshold"]
        v = prefix[j] if j < len(prefix) else 0
        node = node["le"] if v <= z else node["gt"]


def process(config, requests):
    rules = config["rules"]
    timeout = config["idle_timeout"]
    limit = config["packet_limit"]
    W = config["prefix_width"]
    tree = config["fallback"]
    flows = {}
    last_time = 0
    responses = []

    def expire(t, events):
        due = sorted(fid for fid, fl in flows.items()
                     if fl["decided"] is None and t - fl["last"] > timeout)
        for fid in due:
            fl = flows[fid]
            cls = eval_tree(tree, fl["feats"][:W])
            fl["decided"] = {"class": cls, "reason": "idle", "rule": None,
                              "at": fl["n"], "time": t}
            events.append({"type": "decision", "flow": fid, "class": cls,
                           "reason": "idle", "at": fl["n"], "time": t, "rule": None})

    def handle_packet(fid, t, source, length, events):
        fl = flows[fid]
        if fl["src"] is None:
            fl["src"] = source
            v = length
        else:
            v = length if source == fl["src"] else -length
        fl["feats"].append(v)
        fl["n"] += 1
        fl["last"] = t
        # audit all rules
        matched = []
        for r in rules:
            k = len(r["ranges"])
            if fl["n"] < k:
                continue
            start = fl["n"] - k
            ok = True
            for i, (lo, hi) in enumerate(r["ranges"]):
                f = fl["feats"][start + i]
                if not (lo <= f <= hi):
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok:
                matched.append(r)
        matched.sort(key=lambda r: r["id"])
        for r in matched:
            k = len(r["ranges"])
            fl["matches"] += 1
            events.append({"type": "match", "flow": fid, "rule": r["id"],
                           "start": fl["n"] - k, "end": fl["n"]})
        if fl["decided"] is None:
            if matched:
                best = sorted(matched, key=lambda r: (-r["priority"], -len(r["ranges"]), r["id"]))[0]
                fl["decided"] = {"class": best["class"], "reason": "key",
                                 "rule": best["id"], "at": fl["n"], "time": t}
                events.append({"type": "decision", "flow": fid, "class": best["class"],
                               "reason": "key", "at": fl["n"], "time": t, "rule": best["id"]})
            elif fl["n"] >= limit:
                cls = eval_tree(tree, fl["feats"][:W])
                fl["decided"] = {"class": cls, "reason": "packet_limit", "rule": None,
                                 "at": fl["n"], "time": t}
                events.append({"type": "decision", "flow": fid, "class": cls,
                               "reason": "packet_limit", "at": fl["n"], "time": t, "rule": None})

    for req in requests:
        op = req["op"]
        events = []
        if op == "open":
            t = req["time"]; fid = req["flow"]
            expire(t, events)
            flows[fid] = {"src": None, "feats": [], "n": 0, "last": t,
                          "decided": None, "matches": 0}
            last_time = t
        elif op == "tick":
            t = req["time"]
            expire(t, events)
            last_time = t
        elif op == "chunk":
            for p in req["packets"]:
                expire(p["time"], events)
                last_time = p["time"]
                handle_packet(p["flow"], p["time"], p["source"], p["length"], events)
        elif op == "close":
            t = req["time"]; fid = req["flow"]
            expire(t, events)
            last_time = t
            fl = flows[fid]
            if fl["decided"] is None:
                cls = eval_tree(tree, fl["feats"][:W])
                fl["decided"] = {"class": cls, "reason": "end", "rule": None,
                                 "at": fl["n"], "time": t}
                events.append({"type": "decision", "flow": fid, "class": cls,
                               "reason": "end", "at": fl["n"], "time": t, "rule": None})
            d = fl["decided"]
            events.append({"type": "closed", "flow": fid, "packets": fl["n"],
                           "matches": fl["matches"], "class": d["class"],
                           "reason": d["reason"], "rule": d["rule"]})
            del flows[fid]
        elif op == "checkpoint":
            responses.append({"checkpoint": None})
            continue
        else:
            raise ValueError(op)
        responses.append({"events": events})
    return responses
